activity_summary: At home you said the three sentences were under Prices and that you had bought nothing. You said the scarcity was their talk, and that you had not been in the chamber. Then you stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the three sentences and stopped.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Heard, and not bought

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The scarcity is their talk. I was not in the chamber.
